title: Dell Secure Connect Gateway - Virtual Edition, versions prior to 5.36.00.16, contains a Use of… (CVE-2026-80498)
description: Dell Secure Connect Gateway - Virtual Edition versions prior to 5.36.00.16 contain a vulnerability involving the use of a hard-coded cryptographic key. This flaw allows a low privileged local attacker to potentially expose sensitive information. The vulnerability is identified as CVE-2026-80498 and has a high severity rating with a CVSS score of 7.8.
